name: Twinwatch Bastion
short_role: A cold ridge fort split between two exposed defensive posts.
question: Can both posts stay staffed without making either one disposable?

spatial_rule.label: Staff both marked bastions with living combat defenders to reduce room damage by 1.

starter_plan.title: Staff both bastions
starter_plan.intent: Hold the west gatehouse with pikes and put a mobile combat reserve beside the east arsenal to activate shared protection.
starter_plan.tradeoff: The central magazine has no dedicated defender if either post is drawn away.

placements.reason: keeps reserves central between the posts

doctrine_geometry.opening: Reinforce each bastion locally and accept a thin transfer corridor.
doctrine_geometry.fit: Layered Masonry hardens the two post clusters without pretending they form one Greywatch core.
doctrine_geometry.risk: Pressure through Bell Court can separate the clusters.

doctrine_geometry.opening: Staff both anchors while keeping Bell Court open for relief movement.
doctrine_geometry.fit: Open Lanes preserves the transfer space between Twinwatch's distant posts.
doctrine_geometry.risk: The central magazine has no permanent guard.

doctrine_geometry.opening: Keep the supply cache central and hold one reserve behind the weaker post.
doctrine_geometry.fit: Measured Stores makes the shared magazine a real reserve instead of a third front.
doctrine_geometry.risk: A simultaneous two-post attack can spend the reserve too early.

doctrine_geometry.opening: Assign one combat specialist to each bastion and hold Relief Order for the first split.
doctrine_geometry.fit: Posted Orders directly rewards the paired staffed anchors Twinwatch requires.
doctrine_geometry.risk: Command hunters can punish the same assignments that activate the keep.

recovery_profile.question: Which post can be restored without abandoning the other?
